answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 14118 Country: United States of America Title: Asalam Alaykum Sheikh, I have a question regarding the Isha prayer. I live in the Unites States and the Isha prayer is at 10:30pm, and have school the next day, and 10:30 pm is too late for me. So my question is..Is it permissable to pray Isha before time? Question: Asalam Alaykum Sheikh, I have a question regarding the Isha prayer. I live in the Unites States and the Isha prayer is at 10:30pm, and have school the next day, and 10:30 pm is too late for me. So my question is..Is it permissable to pray Isha before time? Answer ID: 14118 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 975/780=L/1430) If the time of Isha arrives in United States at 10:30, you should perform Isha Salah after 10:30. Performing salah in time is a precondition for salah to be valid, a salah performed before time is invalid; rather it is necessary to re-perform it after the arrival of time. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
